tagging_basis: OCR H432 numbered specification sections (lettered learning outcomes as evidence)

units.label: 1(a)
units.summary: Explain what is meant by an alkali.

units.label: 1(b)
units.summary: Write the ionic equation for neutralisation of an acid by an alkali.

units.label: 1(c)(i)
units.summary: Calculate enthalpy change of neutralisation from calorimetry data to 3 sf.
units.difficulty_basis: Multi-step q equals mcdT calculation with mixed volumes

units.label: 1(c)(ii)
units.summary: Explain why a different volume and concentration of HCl gives a greater temperature rise.
units.difficulty_basis: Unfamiliar proportional reasoning about total volume

units.label: 2(a)(i)
units.summary: Write the equation with state symbols for the second ionisation energy of calcium.

units.label: 2(a)(ii)
units.summary: Describe calcium with water, explain redox and explain reactivity difference of Mg and Ca.
units.difficulty_basis: Six-mark levels response combining equation, observations and ionisation trends

units.label: 2(b)(i)
units.summary: Calculate expected gas volume at RTP from barium carbonate and acid to 3 sf.
units.difficulty_basis: Two-step mole and gas volume calculation

units.label: 2(b)(ii)
units.summary: Suggest two reasons the collected gas volume is lower than calculated.

units.label: 2(b)(iii)
units.summary: Suggest a modification to the apparatus to give a more accurate gas volume.

units.label: 3(a)(i)
units.summary: Complete a titration table by calculating titres.

units.label: 3(a)(ii)
units.summary: Calculate the mean titre from concordant results.
units.difficulty_basis: Single step selection of concordant titres

units.label: 3(a)(iii)
units.summary: Calculate mass of malic acid per tablet in mg from titration data.
units.difficulty_basis: Five-mark multi-step with dilution, three tablets and unit conversion

units.label: 3(b)
units.summary: State and explain the effect of rinsing a burette with water on the titre.

units.label: 3(c)
units.summary: Draw cis and trans isomers formed from malic acid.
units.difficulty_basis: Unfamiliar structure requiring E/Z isomerism reasoning

units.label: 4(a)
units.summary: State and explain the boiling point trend of straight chain alkanes.

units.label: 4(b)(i)
units.summary: Write the equation for complete combustion of pentane.

units.label: 4(b)(ii)
units.summary: Calculate mass of CO2 formed per kJ released from combusting pentane.
units.difficulty_basis: Multi-step link of enthalpy and equation

units.label: 4(b)(iii)
units.summary: Complete an enthalpy profile diagram for combustion of pentane with labels.
units.difficulty_basis: Diagram conventions with formulae and labels

units.label: 4(b)(iv)
units.summary: Estimate the enthalpy of combustion of butane from the trend in the table.

units.label: 4(c)
units.summary: Draw and name the two other structural isomers of C5H12.

units.label: 4(d)(i)
units.summary: Write the equation for formation of C3H7Br from propane and bromine.

units.label: 4(d)(ii)
units.summary: Explain what is meant by homolytic fission.

units.label: 4(d)(iii)
units.summary: Complete the propagation equations for bromination of propane.

units.label: 4(d)(iv)
units.summary: Explain why two structural isomers of C3H7Br are formed.
units.difficulty_basis: Single-idea recall of limitation of radical substitution

units.label: 5(a)(i)
units.summary: Draw a dot-and-cross diagram for chloromethane.

units.label: 5(a)(ii)
units.summary: Name the shape of chloromethane and give the H-C-Cl bond angle.

units.label: 5(b)
units.summary: Predict and explain the H-C-Cl angle in chloroethene compared with chloromethane.
units.difficulty_basis: Unfamiliar molecule requiring electron pair repulsion

units.label: 5(c)
units.summary: Describe purification of 2-chlorobutane with reasons and calculate expected mass from percentage yield.
units.difficulty_basis: Six-mark levels response combining practical technique and yield calculation

units.label: 5(d)(i)
units.summary: Deduce alkene X and reagents for a two-stage synthesis of a diol.

units.label: 5(d)(ii)
units.summary: Name the mechanism of hydrolysis of a bromoalkane with aqueous alkali.

units.label: 6(a)(i)
units.summary: Draw the ions responsible for two peaks in the mass spectrum of a ketone.

units.label: 6(a)(ii)
units.summary: Explain the small peak at m/z 73.

units.label: 6(b)(i)
units.summary: State the effect of infrared radiation on covalent bonds.

units.label: 6(b)(ii)
units.summary: Identify two functional groups in an isomer from its IR spectrum and explain.
